packages.label: יִחוּדָא עִלָּאָה וְקַבָּלָה
packages.reason: All nodes share the nature of the upper, Shabbat-level divine unity — the higher covenant (brit ila'ah), kabbalah / esoteric wisdom, the שדי-name in its Shabbat dimension, and the posuk 'Hishtachavu' whose initials spell Kabbalah. שדי also equates to 'there is sufficiency in My divinity for all creatures,' the theological ground of the upper covenant. שמש (sun) = ברית עלאה connects via shared nature of upper/solar brit. All 10 nodes belong to the same essential domain: the supernal unity expressed through the Shabbat-time covenant observance and esoteric wisdom.
nodes: מי שהוא שומר הברית, שזווגו משבת לשבת
merge_notes: Component 9 ({שמש, ברית עלאה}) merged in: שמש = ברית עלאה shares the nature of the upper/solar covenant, directly parallel to שדי של שבת = יחודא עלאה (same Shabbat-level, upper-unity domain).
שיש די באלקותי לכל בריה merged in via shared node שדי (edge 2875), extending the שדי cluster within this package.

packages.label: יִחוּדָא תַּתָּאָה וּמְטַ"ט וַהֲלָכָה
packages.reason: All nodes share the nature of the lower, weekday-level divine governance — Metatron (מט"ט) rules the six weekdays, the halacha / revealed wisdom in its weekday dimension, the posuk 'Harie'u' whose initials spell Halacha, the deshe (grass/small people with frequent conjugal union), and the Shabbat-Shekhinah garbed in Metatron during the six days. הנהגת הקדוש ברוך הוא בששת ימי החל = יחודא תתאה = the core nature of this package. זיז שדי = Metatron (the great bird of the field) = lower unity. ששה סדרי משנה and מכנף הארץ are further aspects of Metatron's domain.
nodes: הנהגת הקדוש ברוך הוא בששת ימי החל
מי שזווגו בששת ימי החל, ואף על פי כן הוא שומר את בריתו על פי התורה, שאינו יוצא מדיני התורה

packages.label: דִּבּוּר הַמֵּאִיר וּתְבוּנוֹת הַתּוֹרָה
packages.reason: All nodes share the nature of the illuminating word / Torah depth dimension. The bird (צפור / צפרתא) is the bechina of illuminating speech, which mediates between מים (= the human being at the lower level) and שמים (= the depths of Torah). תבן = תבונה, שמים = תבונות התורה — the upper destination of illuminating speech. מים = אדם — the lower starting point. The צפור stands ankle-deep in מים (=אדם) with its head in the heaven (=תבונות התורה), embodying the mediating role of illuminating speech.
merge_notes: Component 7 ({תבן, תבונה, שמים, תבונות התורה}) merged in: these share the nature of Torah depth, which is the upper pole of the bird-metaphor (the bird's head reaches the heavens = תבונות התורה). Same conceptual domain as illuminating speech.

Component 8 ({מים, אדם}) merged in: מים = אדם is the lower pole of the bird-metaphor (the bird stands ankle-deep in water = the human being at a low level). Same structural image as the speech package.

packages.label: פְּגַם הַבְּרִית וּמִשְׁכַּן בְּחֻרְבָּנֵהּ
packages.label_en: Covenant Violation and the Destroyed Tabernacle
packages.reason: All nodes share the nature of brit violation and its structural consequences. The 'forty lashes minus one' = the bechina of פגם הברית (covenant blemish) = תוספות (excess/transgression of boundaries). משכן בחרבנה (Tabernacle in its destruction) = ל"ט מלקות. The good mirror nodes (משכן בבנינה, ל"ט אורות) are included from the 2-node isolated component because they share the SAME structural domain (Mishkan/39-count), being the identical metaphor applied to the positive pole. Dominant polarity is evil (brit violation, 39 lashes, destruction) with an embedded good mirror.
merge_notes: Component 5 ({משכן בבנינה, ל"ט אורות}) merged in: these 2 nodes share the same Mishkan/39-count structural nature as the larger Component 4, being the positive pole of the identical metaphor (Mishkan in construction = 39 lights vs. Mishkan in destruction = 39 lashes). Merged on shared NATURE (the Mishkan/39 structural framework), not cause-effect.

packages.label: גֵּאוּת וַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה
packages.reason: גאות (arrogance) and גדלות (self-aggrandizement) are explicitly stated to be the bechina of עבודה זרה (idolatry/alien worship). The Rebbe teaches that pride is structurally identical to idolatry — both are expressions of the same evil orientation: claiming autonomy from God. This 3-node cluster is the evil mirror of the כבוד package (humility/honor of Heaven), but forms its own distinct evil cluster as it is internally bechina-connected.

packages.label: שְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית בִּשְׁתֵּי בְּחִינוֹת וְקְדֻשַּׁת הַזִּוּוּג
packages.label_en: Two-Level Covenant Observance and Holiness of Union
packages.reason: יחודא עלאה ויחודא תתאה (compound node) = שמירת הברית בשתי בחינות. This compound node is distinct from the individual יחודא עלאה and יחודא תתאה nodes — it represents the SYNTHESIS of both levels as the brit's two-mode observance. צבי לצדיק = קדשת הזווג — the beauty/glory of the tzaddik is the bechina of the holiness of marital union. These share the nature of integrated/holy brit observance at its most refined level. The 2-node component (צבי לצדיק, קדשת הזווג) merged here on shared nature: kedushat hazivug is the same domain as brit shmirah.
merge_notes: Component 13 ({צבי לצדיק, קדשת הזווג}) merged in: kedushat hazivug is the positive bechina of covenant holiness, same domain as שמירת הברית בשתי בחינות. Merged on shared NATURE (the sanctity of marital union as an expression of brit observance), not cause-effect.

packages.label: תְּשׁוּבָה וְיַרְקָא
packages.reason: ירקא = תשובה (from the midrash on 'vayarék et chanichav' — he animated them with the portion of Shoftim about teshuva). ירקא שקל = תשובת המשקל (weighed/measured repentance). This 4-node cluster captures the repentance domain: the specific quality of illuminated speech that shows a person the places where they need to do teshuva, and the weighed/calibrated form of that teshuva. These are not large enough to stand alone as a 2-node cluster and naturally belong here. Kept as a distinct package (4 nodes, not 1-2) rather than merging into the speech package, because teshuva is the GOAL that illuminating speech reaches, not structurally identical TO the speech itself.
